theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_pf_ext_action_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U K : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (hs : ℕ → Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n) (h : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (R.carrier \ K) = 0 → (∀ j, Continuous (hs j)) → Continuous h → TendstoUniformlyOn hs h atTop K → Tendsto (fun j => R.action (hs j)) atTop (𝓝 (R.action h))
